property.name: block.size
property.description: Block size in bytes. Valid values are 1024, 2048, 4096. This specifies the size of blocks in bytes. Valid block-size values are powers of two from 1024 up to 65536.

property.name: inode.size
property.description: Specifies the size of each inode in bytes. Default is 256 bytes. Must be a power of 2 and at least 128.

property.name: reserved.blocks.percentage
property.description: Specifies the percentage of the filesystem blocks reserved for the super-user. Default is 5%.

property.name: journal.size
property.description: Create a journal of the given size in megabytes. The size must be between 1024 and 10240000 filesystem blocks.

property.name: filesystem.label
property.description: Set the volume label for the filesystem. The maximum length is 16 bytes.

property.name: filesystem.uuid
property.description: Set the universally unique identifier (UUID) of the filesystem. The UUID must be in the format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal digits).

property.name: inode.ratio
property.description: Creates an inode for every bytes-per-inode bytes of space on the disk. Default is 16384. Larger ratio means fewer inodes.

property.name: stride.size
property.description: Configure the filesystem for a RAID array with stride-size filesystem blocks. This is the number of blocks read or written to disk before moving to the next disk. Must be a positive integer.

property.name: stripe.width
property.description: Configure the filesystem for a RAID array with stripe-width filesystem blocks per stripe. Typically stride * number_of_data_disks.

property.name: features.enabled
property.description: Filesystem features to enable. Common features include: has_journal, extent, huge_file, flex_bg, 64bit, dir_nlink, extra_isize.

property.name: mount.options
property.description: Default mount options for the filesystem. Common options: defaults, noatime, nodiratime, barrier=0.

property.name: root.directory.owner
property.description: Set the owner user:group for the root directory of the filesystem.
